headlines.title: Bitwise calls the Clarity failure a speed bump
headlines.signal: CoinDesk, Sep 17: Matt Hougan said the failed vote makes the road bumpier but does not change the trend. Coinbase and Circle shares fell about 10%. No new law. The industry is waiting on SEC and CFTC rules.

headlines.title: Clarity Act fails; about $570 million of longs liquidated
headlines.signal: CoinDesk, Sep 16: the Senate blocked the Clarity Act. About $571 million of bullish futures were liquidated, the most since Aug 22, with roughly $190 million each in bitcoin and ether longs. Bitcoin was about $75,700 after having traded near $80,000. Spot bitcoin ETFs shed about $450 million, the worst day since June. XRP longs lost about $30 million and Solana longs about $22 million. Rulemaking shifts to the SEC and CFTC. The bill is done for 2026.

headlines.title: Senate Clarity Act cloture vote is set for Tuesday
headlines.signal: CoinDesk, Sep 15: the Senate votes Tuesday on whether to advance the Clarity Act. A research note said a surprise yes could push bitcoin through $82k toward $88–90k, and a no could pull it toward $73k. Ether was described as the larger beneficiary if the bill advances. This is the setup, not the result.
